question: Using Section 7B.05 and Figure 7B-2, describe the required sign sequence for entering and leaving a reduced school speed-limit zone.
model_answer: Direct Answer: Entering a reduced school speed limit zone, drivers must first encounter a School (S1-1) sign in advance, then the School Speed Limit assembly or School Speed Limit When Flashing (S5-1) sign placed at or near the point where the zone begins; a Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead (S4-5/S4-5a) sign is recommended in advance where the speed reduction exceeds 10 mph, and if used it must be followed by the School Speed Limit sign or assembly. Leaving the zone, the downstream end must be marked with an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign, with the resumed speed limit (R2-1) optionally shown. Figure 7B-2 illustrates this full sequence in both travel directions. Standards (mandatory): - "A School Speed Limit assembly (see Figure 7B-1) or a School Speed Limit When Flashing (S5-1) sign (see Figure 7B-1) shall be used to indicate the speed limit where a reduced school speed limit zone has been established based upon an engineering study or where a reduced school speed limit is specified for such areas by statute. The School Speed Limit assembly or School Speed Limit When Flashing sign shall be placed at or as near as practicable to the point where the reduced school speed limit zone begins (see Figures 7B-2 and 7B-4)." - "If a reduced school speed limit zone has been established, a School (S1-1) sign shall be installed in advance (see Table 2C-3 for advance placement guidelines) of the first School Speed Limit sign assembly or S5-1 sign that is encountered in each direction as traffic approaches the reduced school speed limit zone (see Figures 7B-2 and 7B-4)." - "If used, the Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead sign shall be followed by a School Speed Limit sign or a School Speed Limit assembly." - "Except as provided in Paragraph 4 of this Section, the downstream end of an authorized and posted reduced school speed limit zone shall be identified with an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign (see Figures 7B-1, 7B-2, and 7B-4)." - Where higher fines apply only to speeding: "a FINES HIGHER (R2-6P), FINES DOUBLE (R2-6aP), or $XX FINE (R2-6bP) plaque shall be posted with the School Speed Limit (S5-1) sign and shall not be posted beneath the School Zone (S1-1) sign (see Section 7B.05)." Guidance (recommended): - "A Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead (S4-5 or S4-5a) sign (see Figure 7B-1) should be used to inform road users of a reduced speed zone where the speed limit is being reduced by more than 10 mph, or where engineering judgment indicates that advance notice would be appropriate." Visual evidence: - [Image 1] Figure 7B-2 shows the complete two-direction sequence: an advance School (S1-1) sign with optional SCHOOL (S4-3P) plaque, a Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead (S4-5) sign, the School Speed Limit assembly (S4-3P/R2-1/S4-1P) at the zone beginning, and at the downstream end an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) or END SCHOOL ZONE (S5-2) sign with an optional Speed Limit 45 (R2-1) sign above. - [Image 2] Figure 7B-1 depicts the component signs of the sequence, including the School Speed Limit assembly options (S4-3P, R2-1, S4-1P, S4-2P, S4-4P, S4-6P), the S5-1 School Speed Limit When Flashing sign, the S4-5/S4-5a Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead signs, and the S5-2/S5-3 end-of-zone signs. - [Image 3] The Section 7B.05 text page shows the Standard paragraphs establishing the S1-1 advance sign, zone-beginning assembly placement, and S5-3 end-of-zone requirements. - [Image 4] The Section 7B.06/7B.07 page contains the higher-fines plaque provisions and the option for using an END SCHOOL ZONE sign where zones end coincidentally. - [Image 5] Full-page view of Figure 7B-2 confirming the layout of signs approaching and leaving the school speed zone in both directions. - [Image 6] Figure 7B-4 shows an analogous sequence for a school zone with higher fines only for speeding, with fines plaques (R2-6P/R2-6aP/R2-6bP) posted below the School Speed Limit assembly. Citations: - Section 7B.05 Standard §1 (p.978) - Section 7B.05 Standard §2 (p.978) - Section 7B.05 Standard §14 (p.980) - Section 7B.05 Standard §3 (p.978) - Section 7B.06 Standard §3 (p.980) - Section 7B.05 Guidance §13 (p.980) - Figure 7B-2 (p.975) - Figure 7B-1 (p.973) - Page 1019 - Page 1024 - Page 1016 - Page 1020
gold_answer: Approaching traffic first encounters an advance School (S1-1) sign, then the School Speed Limit assembly or S5-1 at the beginning of the reduced zone. The downstream end is normally marked by S5-3 END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT; S5-2 END SCHOOL ZONE may be used when both zones end together, with a downstream R2-1 optionally mounted.
